messages:
Devon: Heads-up — need to shift the weekday triage call for next two weeks because of APAC coverage overlap. Current 21:00 UTC is killing people in APAC.
Sam: +1, I was about to ask. What window are we considering?
Devon: Thinking 18:30 UTC (30 mins earlier) for next 2 weeks, then reassess. Keeps PST folks in evening and makes it manageable for SGT.
Maya: 18:30 works for me. Will that still cover the usual post-deploy checks?
Devon: Yes — plan is 30m strict: 10m quick incident roundup, 10m RFC/design callouts, 10m handoffs & coverage.
Jordan: Can we add a quick agenda slot to decide fallback policy if k8s autoscaler flaps? That was messy last Friday.
Devon: Good call. Agenda draft updated below.
Devon: AGENDA (18:30-19:00 UTC):
- 18:30 (10m) Incident roundup: open Sev2/Sev3s, owner, current status
- 18:40 (10m) Ops callouts: recent deploy regressions, autoscaler fallback decision
- 18:50 (10m) Handoffs & escalation roster: confirm on-call for night + escalation path
Devon: ACTIONS: please react with :thumbsup: if you can attend at 18:30 UTC next Mon/Wed/Fri, or reply with conflicts. Also volunteer for escalation lead for the night of Mon 4/11.
Sam: :thumbsup: I'm in Mon/Wed/Fri. Can take escalation lead Mon night if needed.
Maya: I can do Wed nights. Can't on Fri next week (travel).
Jordan: I have a conflict Mon 18:30-19:15 UTC but can join Wed/Fri.
Ops: We'll prep the incident list in the shared doc before the call. Link: https://redwood.internal/docs/oncall/triage-running-sheet (please open)
Devon: Thanks — Ops, when you post the list, can you tag owners inline like `owner: @name` so we can scan quickly?
Ops: Yep, we'll use this format in the sheet: `incident_id | sev | owner | short status | link`.
Devon: For escalation: prefer primary oncall -> escalation lead -> eng pager -> infra lead. If escalation lead is same as primary oncall, secondary will be the on-call-backup.
Maya: Quick Q: are we still using the canary fallback flow (roll to previous model) for runtime infra? I remember an RFC but not sure it's live.
Sam: RFC-314 landed for canary fallback but not enabled by default. We can discuss enabling for k8s autoscaler in the Ops slot.
Devon: Cool. Also adding a tiny checklist for the handoff: `1) open incidents updated, 2) KV cache flush status, 3) any long-running evals noted, 4) who to call for db access`.
Jordan: Can someone paste the call bridge + emergency dial-in pin? I lost it.
Devon: Bridge: zoom.us/j/87654321, passcode: infer123. Emergency dial-in: +1-555-0100, pin 2345#.
Sam: I'll set a calendar event and invite eng-oncall list and APAC group.
Maya: If you're changing the time, can we add a rotating APAC-liaison for the Wed calls? Someone local to triage quick-region issues.
Devon: Good idea — propose `APAC-liaison` slot on Wed. Volunteers?
Jordan: I can be APAC-liaison next Wed.
Ops: Added incident table stub for Monday. Will tag owners by EOD.
oncall-bot: NOTE: Upcoming oncall handoff window adjusted in schedule service. Old: 21:00 UTC, New temporary: 18:30 UTC (Mon/Wed/Fri) for 2 weeks. See /oncall schedule.
Devon: Awesome — last thing: if you can't attend, please post a 1-line handoff note in this thread before 18:00 UTC on the day. Helps keep the call under 30m.
Sam: Will do. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
Maya: Thanks — see you Wed.
Jordan: Cheers.
